rules.DR0: the current rule: listed mass >= theta_d or WHO head >= theta_who, fitted jointly
rules.DR1: logistic regression on the outputs (FEATURES) >= theta_d, cross-fitted by photographer; replaces both signals
rules.DR2_top3: listed mass among the top 3 species >= theta_d, jointly with the WHO head
rules.DR2_top5: listed mass among the top 5 species >= theta_d, jointly with the WHO head
rules.DR3_max: max(species listed mass, genus head's listed mass) >= theta_d, jointly with the WHO head
rules.DR3_mix: weight x species listed mass + (1 - weight) x genus head's listed mass >= theta_d, jointly with the WHO head; weight fitted on calibration at each target's point fit
rules.DR4: DR0's thresholds; a call only a WHO signal makes, with listed mass and WHO head both under CONFIDENT_DANGER, becomes we don't know (keep away); a variant, since it changes what the verdicts mean

threshold_note: theta_d is the threshold on each rule's own score, which stands in for the listed mass

dr1.trained_on: WHO-listed (1) against neither WHO-listed nor viper or elapid (0); every photo scored out of fold

win_rule: a rule wins when its validation false alarms at the 0.95 target sit below DR0's with non-overlapping 95% photographer-bootstrap intervals and its O3 is no worse; DR4 also needs its validation WHO recall (O2) to reach the target

no_snake.source: front end: box_conf >= tau_snake, fitted so 99% of calibration photos keep a snake; every calibration photo is a real snake and there is no licensed non-snake set, so this is the only fit we can defend and no false-snake rate is measured; a photo with no box counts as no snake
